  function pageMain() {
    const D = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("data").textContent);
    const h = (tag, a, ...kids) => {
      const e = document.createElement(tag);
      for (const k in a || {}) {
        if (k === "class") e.className = a[k];
        else if (k === "text") e.textContent = a[k];
        else if (k.slice(0, 2) === "on") e.addEventListener(k.slice(2), a[k]);
        else e.setAttribute(k, a[k]);
      }
      kids.flat().forEach((c) => c != null && e.append(c.nodeType ? c : document.createTextNode(c)));
      return e;
    };
    const inr = (n) => "\u20B9" + n.toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
    // Default view: GRID
    const st = { q: "", cat: "", minDisc: 0, inStock: false, key: "discountPct", dir: -1, view: "grid" };
    const SORTS = [
      ["discountPct:-1", "Highest discount"], ["savings:-1", "Biggest savings"], ["price:1", "Price, low to high"],
      ["price:-1", "Price, high to low"], ["rating:-1", "Top rated"], ["name:1", "Name, A to Z"],
    ];

    // Extract categories
    const catCounts = new Map();
    D.items.forEach((it) => {
      const cats = (it.categories && it.categories.length) ? it.categories : (it.category ? [it.category] : []);
      cats.forEach((c) => {
        catCounts.set(c, (catCounts.get(c) || 0) + 1);
      });
    });
    const uniqueCats = Array.from(catCounts.keys()).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    let catSel = null;
    if (uniqueCats.length > 1) {
      catSel = h("select", {
        class: "sel sel-cat",
        "aria-label": "Filter by Category",
        onchange: () => {
          st.cat = catSel.value;
          render();
        }
      },
        h("option", { value: "", text: "All Categories (" + D.items.length + ")" }),
        uniqueCats.map((c) => h("option", { value: c, text: c + " (" + catCounts.get(c) + ")" }))
      );
    }

    function visible() {
      const q = st.q.trim().toLowerCase();
      const list = D.items.filter((it) => {
        const matchesQ = !q || (it.name + " " + it.brand + " " + it.variant + " " + (it.category || "")).toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesDisc = it.discountPct >= st.minDisc;
        const matchesStock = !st.inStock || !it.soldOut;
        const matchesCat = !st.cat || it.category === st.cat || (it.categories && it.categories.includes(st.cat));
        return matchesQ && matchesDisc && matchesStock && matchesCat;
      });
      list.sort((a, b) => {
        let av = a[st.key], bv = b[st.key];
        if (av == null || bv == null) return av == null ? (bv == null ? 0 : 1) : -1;
        const c = typeof av === "string" ? av.localeCompare(bv) * st.dir : (av - bv) * st.dir;
        return c || b.discountPct - a.discountPct || b.savings - a.savings || a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
      });
      return list;
    }

    const getProductUrl = (it) => {
      if (!it) return "https://blinkit.com";
      const slug = (it.name || "item").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "") || "item";
      return it.productId ? "https://blinkit.com/prn/" + slug + "/prid/" + it.productId : "https://blinkit.com/s/?q=" + encodeURIComponent(it.name);
    };

    const off = (it) => it.discountPct > 0
      ? h("span", { class: "off " + (it.discountPct >= 40 ? "hi" : it.discountPct >= 25 ? "mid" : "lo") },
          h("span", { class: "pct", text: Math.round(it.discountPct) + "%" }),
          h("span", { class: "lbl", text: "Off" }))
      : h("span", { class: "off lo", text: "\u2013" });
    const pic = (it) => it.image ? h("img", { src: it.image, alt: "", loading: "lazy", referrerpolicy: "no-referrer" }) : h("div", { class: "ph" });

    const COLS = [
      ["name", "Product", 1, "col-prod"],
      ["mrp", "MRP", 1, "col-mrp hide-s"],
      ["price", "Price", 1, "col-price"],
      ["discountPct", "Off", -1, "col-off"],
      ["savings", "Save", -1, "col-save hide-s"],
      ["rating", "Rating", -1, "col-rating hide-s"]
    ];

    function listView(rows) {
      const head = h("tr", {}, COLS.map(([key, label, dir, cls]) => {
        const th = h("th", { class: cls },
          h("button", { text: label + (st.key === key ? (st.dir < 0 ? " \u2193" : " \u2191") : ""), onclick: () => {
            if (st.key === key) st.dir *= -1; else { st.key = key; st.dir = dir; }
            render();
          } }));
        if (st.key === key) th.setAttribute("aria-sort", st.dir < 0 ? "descending" : "ascending");
        return th;
      }));
      const body = rows.map((it) => h("tr", { class: it.soldOut ? "oos" : "" },
        h("td", { class: "col-prod" }, h("a", { class: "prod", href: getProductUrl(it), target: "_blank", rel: "noopener noreferrer" },
          pic(it),
          h("div", { class: "pinfo" },
            h("div", { class: "pn", text: it.name }),
            h("div", { class: "ps" },
              h("span", { text: it.variant }),
              h("span", { text: it.brand }),
              it.category ? h("span", { class: "tag", text: it.category }) : null,
              it.soldOut ? h("span", { class: "tag", text: "Sold out" }) : null)))),
        h("td", { class: "col-mrp hide-s" }, it.discountPct > 0 ? h("span", { class: "mrp", text: inr(it.mrp) }) : ""),
        h("td", { class: "col-price price", text: inr(it.price) }),
        h("td", { class: "col-off" }, off(it)),
        h("td", { class: "col-save hide-s", text: it.savings > 0 ? inr(it.savings) : "\u2013" }),
        h("td", { class: "col-rating hide-s", text: it.rating ? "\u2605 " + it.rating + (it.ratingCount ? " (" + it.ratingCount + ")" : "") : "\u2013" })));
      return h("table", {}, h("thead", {}, head), h("tbody", {}, body));
    }

    function gridView(rows) {
      return h("div", { class: "grid" }, rows.map((it) => h("a", { class: "card" + (it.soldOut ? " oos" : ""), href: getProductUrl(it), target: "_blank", rel: "noopener noreferrer" },
        h("div", { class: "thumb" }, pic(it), it.discountPct > 0 ? off(it) : null),
        h("div", { class: "cname", text: it.name }),
        h("div", { class: "cmeta", text: (it.soldOut ? "Sold out" : it.variant) + (it.category ? " \u00B7 " + it.category : "") }),
        h("div", { class: "cprice" }, h("b", { text: inr(it.price) }), it.discountPct > 0 ? h("s", { text: inr(it.mrp) }) : null))));
    }

    function exportCsv() {
      const q = (v) => {
        let s = String(v == null ? "" : v);
        if (/^[=+\-@]/.test(s)) s = "'" + s;
        return /[",\n]/.test(s) ? '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : s;
      };
      const lines = [["Name", "Category", "Brand", "Variant", "MRP", "Price", "Discount %", "Savings", "In stock", "Rating"]]
        .concat(visible().map((i) => [i.name, i.category || "", i.brand, i.variant, i.mrp, i.price, i.discountPct, i.savings, i.soldOut ? "no" : "yes", i.rating]))
        .map((r) => r.map(q).join(","));
      const a = h("a", { href: URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([lines.join("\n")], { type: "text/csv" })), download: "blinkit-deals.csv" });
      document.body.append(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    }

    // Header summary
    const maxOff = D.items.reduce((m, i) => Math.max(m, i.discountPct), 0);
    const inStockN = D.items.filter((i) => !i.soldOut).length;
    const notes = [];
    if (D.partial) notes.push("Some pages failed to load, so this list may be incomplete.");
    if (D.cancelled) notes.push("Search stopped early by user. Showing " + D.items.length + " products collected so far.");
    else if (!D.complete) notes.push("Stopped at the safety limit of " + D.items.length + " products, so the rest of this subcategory isn't included.");

    const count = h("div", { class: "count" });
    const content = h("div", {});
    const mkChip = (label, on) => { const b = h("button", { class: "chip", "aria-pressed": "false", text: label, onclick: () => { on(); render(); } }); return b; };
    const c25 = mkChip("25%+", () => { st.minDisc = st.minDisc === 25 ? 0 : 25; });
    const c40 = mkChip("40%+", () => { st.minDisc = st.minDisc === 40 ? 0 : 40; });
    const c60 = mkChip("60%+", () => { st.minDisc = st.minDisc === 60 ? 0 : 60; });
    const cStock = mkChip("In stock", () => { st.inStock = !st.inStock; });
    const sel = h("select", { class: "sel", "aria-label": "Sort", onchange: () => { const [k, d] = sel.value.split(":"); st.key = k; st.dir = +d; render(); } },
      h("option", { value: "", hidden: "", text: "Column sort" }), SORTS.map(([v, t]) => h("option", { value: v, text: t })));
    const vGrid = h("button", { text: "Grid", onclick: () => { st.view = "grid"; render(); } });
    const vList = h("button", { text: "List", onclick: () => { st.view = "list"; render(); } });
    const search = h("input", { class: "search", type: "search", placeholder: "Search products or brands", "aria-label": "Search products", oninput: () => { st.q = search.value; render(); } });

    document.getElementById("app").append(h("div", { class: "wrap" },
      h("h1", { text: D.meta.category + " \u203A " + D.meta.subcategory }),
      h("div", { class: "meta" },
        h("span", { text: D.items.length + " products" }),
        h("span", { text: "up to " + Math.round(maxOff) + "% off" }),
        h("span", { text: inStockN + " in stock" })),
      notes.map((n) => h("div", { class: "note", text: n })),
      h("div", { class: "bar" },
        h("div", { class: "bar-row r1" }, search, c25, c40, c60),
        h("div", { class: "bar-row r2" }, cStock, catSel, sel, h("div", { class: "seg" }, vGrid, vList), h("button", { class: "chip btn-csv", text: "Export CSV", onclick: exportCsv }))),
      count, content));

    function render() {
      const rows = visible();
      c25.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.minDisc === 25); c40.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.minDisc === 40); c60.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.minDisc === 60);
      cStock.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.inStock);
      vGrid.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.view === "grid"); vList.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.view === "list");
      sel.value = SORTS.some(([v]) => v === st.key + ":" + st.dir) ? st.key + ":" + st.dir : "";
      if (catSel) catSel.value = st.cat || "";
      count.textContent = "Showing " + rows.length + " of " + D.items.length;
      content.replaceChildren(rows.length ? (st.view === "grid" ? gridView(rows) : listView(rows)) : h("div", { class: "empty", text: "No products match these filters." }));
    }
    render();
  }

  function buildResultsHtml(data) {
    const json = JSON.stringify(data).replace(/</g, "\\u003c").replace(/\u2028/g, "\\u2028").replace(/\u2029/g, "\\u2029");
    const title = data.meta.subcategory + " deals";
    return '<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>' +
      esc(title) + '</title><style>' + RESULTS_CSS + '</style></head><body><div id="app"></div><script id="data" type="application/json">' +
      json + '</script><script>(' + pageMain.toString() + ')()</script></body></html>';
  }

  // Opens results only AFTER fetching is done
  let lastResultsHtml = null;

  function showOverlay(html) {
    let frame = document.getElementById("dh-overlay");
    if (frame) frame.remove();
    frame = document.createElement("div");
    frame.id = "dh-overlay";
    frame.style.cssText = "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483647;background:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column";

    const topBar = document.createElement("div");
    topBar.style.cssText = "display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 16px;background:#f8f9fa;border-bottom:1px solid #e4e7e1";

    const title = document.createElement("span");
    title.style.cssText = "font:600 13px system-ui;color:#171a17";
    title.textContent = "Deal Hunter Results";

    const right = document.createElement("div");
    right.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center";

    const note = document.createElement("span");
    note.style.cssText = "font:12px system-ui;color:#667064";
    note.textContent = "Pop-up blocked by browser:";

    const openTabBtn = document.createElement("button");
    openTabBtn.textContent = "Open in New Tab \u2197";
    openTabBtn.style.cssText = "padding:5px 12px;background:#0c831f;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:6px;font:600 12px system-ui;cursor:pointer";
    openTabBtn.onclick = () => {
      const w = window.open("", "_blank");
      if (w) { w.document.open(); w.document.write(html); w.document.close(); }
    };

    const closeBtn = document.createElement("button");
    closeBtn.textContent = "Close \u2715";
    closeBtn.style.cssText = "padding:5px 12px;background:#fff;color:#667064;border:1px solid #e4e7e1;border-radius:6px;font:500 12px system-ui;cursor:pointer";
    closeBtn.onclick = () => frame.remove();

    right.append(note, openTabBtn, closeBtn);
    topBar.append(title, right);

    const f = document.createElement("iframe");
    f.setAttribute("sandbox", "allow-scripts allow-downloads");
    f.style.cssText = "flex:1;border:0;width:100%";
    f.srcdoc = html;

    frame.append(topBar, f);
    document.body.append(frame);
  }

  function displayResults(html) {
    lastResultsHtml = html;
    $("view-last").hidden = false;
    let opened = false;
    try {
      const w = window.open("", "_blank");
      if (w) {
        w.document.open();
        w.document.write(html);
        w.document.close();
        opened = true;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      opened = false;
    }
    if (!opened) {
      showOverlay(html);
      return "overlay";
    }
    return "tab";
  }

  // ---------- Sidebar (Claude's Pure Light Theme UI) ----------
  const CSS = `

  const HTML = `

        </button>
      </div>
    </header>
    <div class="warn" id="locwarn" hidden>⚠️ Delivery location not detected. Please select your delivery address on Blinkit so prices and stock match your store.</div>
    <div class="body">

        <button role="tab" id="t-kw" aria-selected="true">Search by Keyword</button>
        <button role="tab" id="t-cat" aria-selected="false">Search by Category</button>
      </div>

      <!-- Keyword Search Tab Panel -->
      <section id="p-kw" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px">
        <label>Keyword<input id="kw-input" type="search" placeholder="e.g. sweets, snacks, amul, milk" autocomplete="off" /></label>
        <p class="hint">Sorts by discount on server &amp; fetches pages until discount drops below 59%.</p>
        <button class="primary" id="kw-go" style="width:100%">Find keyword deals</button>

        <div class="divider"></div>

        <div class="kw-quick">
          <div class="kw-quick-label">⚡ Popular Deals (1-Click):</div>
          <div class="kw-chips" id="kw-chips"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="divider"></div>

        <button class="mega-btn" id="kw-all" type="button" style="width:100%">
          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><polygon points="13 2 3 14 12 14 11 22 21 10 12 10 13 2"/></svg>
          Scan All Deals (36 Categories)
        </button>
        <p class="hint" style="margin-top:-4px">Fetches page 1 of 36 essential keywords sorted by discount and displays all deals.</p>
      </section>

      <!-- Category Deals Tab Panel -->
      <section id="p-cat" hidden style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px">
        <label>Category<select id="cat"></select></label>
        <div id="sub-wrap" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px">
          <div class="sub-hdr">
            <span id="sub-count">Subcategories</span>
            <div class="sub-actions" id="sub-actions" hidden>
              <button type="button" id="sub-sel-all">Select all</button>
              <button type="button" id="sub-clr-all">Clear all</button>

        <p class="hint">Fetches Page 1 sorted by discount of each selected subcategory.</p>
        <button class="primary" id="go" style="width:100%" disabled>Find category deals</button>
      </section>
    </div>
    <footer>
      <div class="progress" id="prog" hidden><i id="bar"></i></div>
      <div class="status" id="statusrow">
        <span id="status" role="status">Ready. Enter a keyword or pick a category.</span>
        <button class="link" id="cancel" hidden>Cancel</button>
        <button class="link" id="view-last" hidden>View results &nearr;</button>
      </div>

  const host = document.createElement("div");
  host.id = ROOT_ID;
  host.style.cssText = "position:fixed;z-index:2147483647;top:0;right:0;pointer-events:none";
  const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
  shadow.innerHTML = "<style>" + CSS + "</style>" + HTML;
  document.body.appendChild(host);
  const $ = (id) => shadow.getElementById(id);

  const sel = { cat: null, groups: [], selectedGroups: new Set() };
  const groupCache = new Map();
  let busy = false, ctrl = null;

  function updateContextUI() {
    CTX = getDynamicContext();
    const loc = CTX.locality || "";
    if (loc.toLowerCase().startsWith("store")) {
      $("ctx").textContent = loc;
    } else {
      $("ctx").textContent = loc + (CTX.chainId ? ", store " + CTX.chainId : "");
    }
    $("locwarn").hidden = CTX.detected;
  }
  updateContextUI();

  const setOpen = (open) => {
    $("root").classList.toggle("open", open);
    if (open) {
      updateContextUI();
      $("kw-input").focus();
    }
  };
  $("launcher").onclick = () => setOpen(true);
  $("minimize").onclick = () => setOpen(false);
  $("close").onclick = () => host.remove();
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") setOpen(false); });

  function setStatus(msg, isError) {
    $("status").textContent = msg;
    $("statusrow").classList.toggle("error", !!isError);
  }
  function setBusy(on) {
    busy = on;
    $("go").disabled = on || sel.selectedGroups.size === 0;
    $("kw-go").disabled = on;
    $("kw-input").disabled = on;
    $("cat").disabled = on;
    shadow.querySelectorAll("#sub-list input[type=checkbox]").forEach((cb) => (cb.disabled = on));
    $("sub-sel-all").disabled = on;
    $("sub-clr-all").disabled = on;
    $("t-kw").disabled = on;
    $("t-cat").disabled = on;
    if ($("kw-all")) $("kw-all").disabled = on;
    shadow.querySelectorAll(".kw-chip").forEach((b) => (b.disabled = on));
    $("cancel").hidden = !on;
    $("prog").hidden = !on;
    if (!on) $("bar").style.width = "0";
  }
  const setProgress = (f) => { $("bar").style.width = Math.round(Math.min(1, f) * 100) + "%"; };
  $("cancel").onclick = () => ctrl && ctrl.abort();

  $("view-last").onclick = () => {
    if (lastResultsHtml) {
      const w = window.open("", "_blank");
      if (w) { w.document.open(); w.document.write(lastResultsHtml); w.document.close(); }
      else { showOverlay(lastResultsHtml); }
    }
  };

  // Tabs: Search by Keyword / Search by Category
  function showTab(name) {
    const isKw = name === "kw";
    $("t-kw").setAttribute("aria-selected", isKw);
    $("t-cat").setAttribute("aria-selected", !isKw);
    $("p-kw").hidden = !isKw;
    $("p-cat").hidden = isKw;
    if (isKw) $("kw-input").focus();
    else if (!$("cat").value) $("cat").focus();
  }
  $("t-kw").onclick = () => showTab("kw");
  $("t-cat").onclick = () => showTab("cat");

  // Populate Categories Dropdown (Claude's original optgroups)
  (function fillCategories() {
    const c = $("cat");
    c.innerHTML = "";
    const first = document.createElement("option");
    first.value = ""; first.textContent = "Choose a category";
    c.appendChild(first);
    const groups = {};
    TAXONOMY.forEach((col, idx) => (groups[col.superCategory || "Other"] = groups[col.superCategory || "Other"] || []).push({ col, idx }));
    Object.keys(groups).forEach((sc) => {
      const og = document.createElement("optgroup");
      og.label = sc;
      groups[sc].forEach(({ col, idx }) => {
        const o = document.createElement("option");
        o.value = idx; o.textContent = col.name;
        og.appendChild(o);
      });
      c.appendChild(og);
    });
  })();

  function updateSubUI() {
    const selCount = sel.selectedGroups.size;
    const totalCount = sel.groups.length;
    $("sub-count").textContent = totalCount ? "Subcategories (" + selCount + "/" + totalCount + ")" : "Subcategories";
    $("go").disabled = busy || selCount === 0;
    $("go").textContent = selCount > 0 ? "Find category deals (" + selCount + ")" : "Select at least 1 subcategory";
    if (selCount > 0) {
      setStatus("Selected " + selCount + " subcategories. Ready to scan.");
    } else if (totalCount > 0) {
      setStatus("Please select at least 1 subcategory.", true);
    }
  }

  function fillSubs(groups) {
    sel.groups = groups || [];
    // Auto-select all subcategories by default
    sel.selectedGroups = new Set((groups || []).map((g) => String(g.id)));

    const list = $("sub-list");
    list.innerHTML = "";

    if (!groups || !groups.length) {
      list.innerHTML = '<div class="sub-placeholder">No subcategories found</div>';
      $("sub-actions").hidden = true;
      updateSubUI();
      return;
    }

    groups.forEach((g) => {
      const item = document.createElement("label");
      item.className = "sub-item";
      const cb = document.createElement("input");
      cb.type = "checkbox";
      cb.value = String(g.id);
      cb.checked = true;
      cb.onchange = () => {
        if (cb.checked) sel.selectedGroups.add(String(g.id));
        else sel.selectedGroups.delete(String(g.id));
        updateSubUI();
      };
      const span = document.createElement("span");
      span.textContent = g.name;
      span.title = g.name;
      item.append(cb, span);
      list.appendChild(item);
    });

    $("sub-actions").hidden = false;
    updateSubUI();
  }

  $("sub-sel-all").onclick = () => {
    if (busy || !sel.groups.length) return;
    sel.selectedGroups = new Set(sel.groups.map((g) => String(g.id)));
    shadow.querySelectorAll("#sub-list input[type=checkbox]").forEach((cb) => (cb.checked = true));
    updateSubUI();
  };

  $("sub-clr-all").onclick = () => {
    if (busy || !sel.groups.length) return;
    sel.selectedGroups.clear();
    shadow.querySelectorAll("#sub-list input[type=checkbox]").forEach((cb) => (cb.checked = false));
    updateSubUI();
  };

  async function loadSubs(cat) {
    if (groupCache.has(cat.uuid)) { fillSubs(groupCache.get(cat.uuid)); return; }
    const list = $("sub-list");
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="sub-placeholder">Loading subcategories\u2026</div>';
    $("sub-actions").hidden = true;
    let groups = [];
    try {
      const c = new AbortController();
      const t = setTimeout(() => c.abort(), 6000);
      const res = await fetch("https://blinkit.com/v1/layout/listing", {
        method: "POST",
        signal: c.signal,
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json", app_client: "consumer_web", lat: CTX.lat, lon: CTX.lon },
        body: JSON.stringify({ collection_uuid: cat.uuid }),
      });
      clearTimeout(t);
      if (res.ok) {
        const json = await res.json();
        ((json && json.response && json.response.snippets) || []).forEach((sn) => {
          const d = sn.data || {};
          const meta = (sn.tracking && sn.tracking.widget_meta) || {};
          const title = (d.selected_title && d.selected_title.text) || (d.unselected_title && d.unselected_title.text) || meta.widget_title || "";
          if (title && meta.widget_id && !groups.some((g) => g.id === meta.widget_id)) groups.push({ id: meta.widget_id, name: title });
        });
      }
    } catch (e) { /* use bundled list */ }
    if (!groups.length) groups = cat.groupings || [];
    groupCache.set(cat.uuid, groups);
    if (sel.cat === cat) fillSubs(groups);
  }

  $("cat").onchange = () => {
    const v = $("cat").value;
    sel.groups = [];
    sel.selectedGroups.clear();
    setBusy(false);
    if (v === "") {
      sel.cat = null;
      $("sub-list").innerHTML = '<div class="sub-placeholder">Choose a category first</div>';
      $("sub-actions").hidden = true;
      $("sub-count").textContent = "Subcategories";
      $("go").disabled = true;
      $("go").textContent = "Find category deals";
      setStatus("Pick a category to start.");
      return;
    }
    sel.cat = TAXONOMY[+v];
    setStatus("Loading subcategories\u2026");
    loadSubs(sel.cat);
  };

  async function fetchSubPage1(catUuid, sub, signal) {
    const cacheKey = `${catUuid}:${sub.id}`;
    if (catDealsCache.has(cacheKey)) {
      return catDealsCache.get(cacheKey);
    }
    const body = {
      offset: "0",
      limit: String(LIMIT),
      collection_filters: "[]",
      collection_group_id: String(sub.id),
      collection_properties: JSON.stringify([{ id: 4179, name: "NEXT_PRODUCT_RECOMMENDATION", value: "true" }]),
      collection_uuid: catUuid,
      exclude_combos: "false",
      last_snippet_type: "product_card_snippet_type_2",
      last_widget_type: "product_container",
      oos_visibility: "true",
      page_index: "0",
      products: "[]",
      total_entities_processed: "0",
      total_pagination_items: String(LIMIT),
      applied_filters: null,
      sort: "discount_desc",
    };
    const url = `https://blinkit.com/v1/layout/listing_widgets?collection_uuid=${encodeURIComponent(catUuid)}&collection_group_id=${encodeURIComponent(sub.id)}&sort=discount_desc`;
    const r = await fetch(url, {
      method: "POST",
      signal,
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", app_client: "consumer_web", lat: CTX.lat, lon: CTX.lon },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
    const json = await r.json();
    const items = parseItems(json);
    catDealsCache.set(cacheKey, items);
    return items;
  }

  // Category deals fetch: fetches Page 1 of each selected subcategory
  $("go").onclick = async () => {
    if (busy || !sel.cat || sel.selectedGroups.size === 0) return;
    updateContextUI();
    if (!CTX.detected) {
      setStatus("Please select your delivery address on Blinkit first.", true);
      return;
    }

    const targetSubs = sel.groups.filter((g) => sel.selectedGroups.has(String(g.id)));
    if (!targetSubs.length) {
      setStatus("Please select at least 1 subcategory.", true);
      return;
    }

    ctrl = new AbortController();
    setBusy(true);
    setStatus("Scanning " + targetSubs.length + " subcategories...");
    setProgress(0.02);

    const seen = new Set();
    const items = [];
    let failedCount = 0;
    let cancelled = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < targetSubs.length; i++) {
      if (ctrl.signal.aborted) {
        cancelled = true;
        break;
      }
      const sub = targetSubs[i];
      setProgress((i + 0.1) / targetSubs.length);
      setStatus("Scanning (" + (i + 1) + "/" + targetSubs.length + "): " + sub.name + "...");

      try {
        const subItems = await fetchSubPage1(sel.cat.uuid, sub, ctrl.signal);
        if (subItems && subItems.length) {
          subItems.forEach((it) => {
            const copy = Object.assign({}, it);
            const key = copy.productId || (copy.name + "|" + copy.variant);
            const subName = sub.name;
            if (!seen.has(key)) {
              seen.add(key);
              copy.category = subName;
              copy.categories = [subName];
              items.push(copy);
            } else {
              const existing = items.find((x) => (x.productId || (x.name + "|" + x.variant)) === key);
              if (existing) {
                if (!existing.categories) existing.categories = [existing.category || subName];
                if (!existing.categories.includes(subName)) existing.categories.push(subName);
              }
            }
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (err.name === "AbortError" || ctrl.signal.aborted) {
          cancelled = true;
          break;
        }
        failedCount++;
      }

      if (i < targetSubs.length - 1 && !ctrl.signal.aborted) {
        await sleep(120);
      }
    }

    setProgress(1);

    if (!items.length) {
      setBusy(false);
      if (cancelled) {
        setStatus("Cancelled.");
        return;
      }
      setStatus("No products found in selected subcategories.", true);
      return;
    }

    items.sort((a, b) => b.discountPct - a.discountPct || b.savings - a.savings);

    const html = buildResultsHtml({
      items,
      complete: !cancelled && failedCount === 0,
      partial: failedCount > 0,
      cancelled,
      meta: {
        category: sel.cat.name,
        subcategory: targetSubs.length + " subcategories (" + items.length + " products)",
        locality: CTX.locality,
        chainId: CTX.chainId,
        at: Date.now(),
      },
    });

    const mode = displayResults(html);
    setStatus((cancelled ? "Stopped early. Found " : "Done! Found ") + items.length + " products across " + targetSubs.length + " subcategories" + (mode === "tab" ? ". Opened in a new tab." : "."));
    setBusy(false);
  };

  // Keyword deals fetch: opens results ONLY AFTER fetch completes
  async function executeKeywordSearch(customKw) {
    if (customKw && typeof customKw === "string") {
      $("kw-input").value = customKw;
    }
    const q = ($("kw-input").value || "").trim();
    if (!q) {
      setStatus("Please enter a keyword to search.", true);
      $("kw-input").focus();
      return;
    }
    if (busy) return;

    updateContextUI();
    if (!CTX.detected) {
      setStatus("Please select your delivery address on Blinkit first.", true);
      return;
    }

    // Check session cache first
    const cacheKey = q.toLowerCase();
    if (searchCache.has(cacheKey)) {
      const cached = searchCache.get(cacheKey);
      const html = buildResultsHtml({
        items: cached.items, complete: cached.complete, partial: cached.partial, cancelled: false,
        meta: { category: 'Search: "' + q + '"', subcategory: cached.items.length + " products (" + cached.pagesScanned + " pages)", locality: CTX.locality, chainId: CTX.chainId, at: Date.now() },
      });
      const mode = displayResults(html);
      setStatus("Loaded " + cached.items.length + " products from session cache" + (mode === "tab" ? ". Opened in a new tab." : "."));
      return;
    }

    ctrl = new AbortController();
    setBusy(true);
    setStatus("Searching '" + q + "' (page 1)...");
    setProgress(0.05);

    try {
      const r = await crawlSearch(q, (count, pages) => {
        setProgress(Math.min(0.95, pages / 15));
        setStatus("Found " + count + " products (" + pages + " pages, 500ms pause)...");
      }, ctrl.signal);

      if (!r.items.length) {
        if (r.cancelled) {
          setStatus("Search cancelled.");
          return;
        }
        throw new Error("No products returned for '" + q + "'. Try another keyword.");
      }

      r.items.forEach((it) => {
        if (!it.category) it.category = cap(q);
        if (!it.categories || !it.categories.length) it.categories = [it.category];
      });
      r.items.sort((a, b) => b.discountPct - a.discountPct || b.savings - a.savings);

      // Save to cache ONLY IF NOT CANCELLED
      if (!r.cancelled) {
        searchCache.set(cacheKey, { items: r.items, complete: r.complete, partial: r.partial, pagesScanned: r.pagesScanned });
      }

      const html = buildResultsHtml({
        items: r.items, complete: r.complete, partial: r.partial, cancelled: r.cancelled,
        meta: { category: 'Search: "' + q + '"', subcategory: r.items.length + " products (" + r.pagesScanned + " pages)", locality: CTX.locality, chainId: CTX.chainId, at: Date.now() },
      });
      const mode = displayResults(html);
      setStatus((r.cancelled ? "Stopped early. Found " : "Done! Found ") + r.items.length + " products across " + r.pagesScanned + " pages" + (mode === "tab" ? ". Opened in new tab." : "."));
    } catch (e) {
      setStatus(e.name === "AbortError" ? "Search cancelled." : e.message, e.name !== "AbortError");
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  // Multi-Category Mega Deal Scout: strictly page 1 of 36 essential categories
  async function scanAllKeywords() {
    if (busy) return;
    updateContextUI();
    if (!CTX.detected) {
      setStatus("Please select your delivery address on Blinkit first.", true);
      return;
    }

    ctrl = new AbortController();
    setBusy(true);
    setProgress(0.01);
    setStatus("Scanning 50 essential categories (page 1 deals)...");

    const seen = new Set();
    const items = [];
    let failed = 0;
    let cancelled = false;

    try {
      for (let i = 0; i < ALL_KEYWORDS.length; i++) {
        if (ctrl.signal && ctrl.signal.aborted) {
          cancelled = true;
          break;
        }
        const kw = ALL_KEYWORDS[i];
        const cacheKey = kw.toLowerCase();
        const fromCache = searchCache.has(cacheKey);

        setStatus("Scanning '" + kw + "' (" + (i + 1) + "/" + ALL_KEYWORDS.length + (fromCache ? " [cached]" : "") + ") · " + items.length + " deals found...");
        setProgress((i + 1) / ALL_KEYWORDS.length);

        let list = null;
        if (fromCache) {
          list = searchCache.get(cacheKey).items;
        } else {
          try {
            list = await fetchKeywordPage0(kw, ctrl.signal);
          } catch (err) {
            if (err.name === "AbortError" || (ctrl.signal && ctrl.signal.aborted)) {
              cancelled = true;
              break;
            }
            failed++;
          }
        }

        if (list && list.length) {
          if (!fromCache) {
            searchCache.set(cacheKey, { items: list, complete: false, partial: false, pagesScanned: 1 });
          }
          const catName = cap(kw);
          for (const rawIt of list) {
            const it = Object.assign({}, rawIt);
            if (it.discountPct > 0) {
              const key = it.productId || (it.name + "|" + it.variant);
              if (!seen.has(key)) {
                seen.add(key);
                it.category = catName;
                it.categories = [catName];
                items.push(it);
              } else {
                const existing = items.find((x) => (x.productId || (x.name + "|" + x.variant)) === key);
                if (existing) {
                  if (!existing.categories) existing.categories = [existing.category || catName];
                  if (!existing.categories.includes(catName)) existing.categories.push(catName);
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }

        if (cancelled) break;

        // Skip the 120ms sleep for cached keywords
        if (!fromCache && i < ALL_KEYWORDS.length - 1) {
          await sleep(120);
          if (ctrl.signal && ctrl.signal.aborted) {
            cancelled = true;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (ctrl.signal && ctrl.signal.aborted) cancelled = true;

      if (!items.length) {
        if (cancelled) {
          setStatus("Scan cancelled.");
          return;
        }
        throw new Error("No discounted products found across keywords.");
      }

      items.sort((a, b) => b.discountPct - a.discountPct || b.savings - a.savings);

      const html = buildResultsHtml({
        items,
        complete: !cancelled,
        partial: failed > 0,
        cancelled: cancelled,
        meta: {
          category: "⚡ All Deals Scout",
          subcategory: items.length + " deals across " + ALL_KEYWORDS.length + " categories" + (cancelled ? " (early stop)" : ""),
          locality: CTX.locality,
          chainId: CTX.chainId,
          at: Date.now(),
        },
      });

      const mode = displayResults(html);
      setStatus((cancelled ? "Stopped early! Showing " : "Done! Found ") + items.length + " deals across " + ALL_KEYWORDS.length + " categories" + (mode === "tab" ? ". Opened in a new tab." : "."));
    } catch (e) {
      if (e.name === "AbortError" || (ctrl.signal && ctrl.signal.aborted)) {
        if (items.length > 0) {
          items.sort((a, b) => b.discountPct - a.discountPct || b.savings - a.savings);
          const html = buildResultsHtml({
            items,
            complete: false,
            partial: failed > 0,
            cancelled: true,
            meta: {
              category: "⚡ All Deals Scout",
              subcategory: items.length + " deals across " + ALL_KEYWORDS.length + " categories (early stop)",
              locality: CTX.locality,
              chainId: CTX.chainId,
              at: Date.now(),
            },
          });
          const mode = displayResults(html);
          setStatus("Stopped early! Showing " + items.length + " deals" + (mode === "tab" ? ". Opened in a new tab." : "."));
        } else {
          setStatus("Scan cancelled.");
        }
      } else {
        setStatus(e.message, true);
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  // Populate Quick Keyword Chips
  const chipsContainer = $("kw-chips");
  if (chipsContainer) {
    chipsContainer.innerHTML = "";
    QUICK_KEYWORDS.forEach((kw) => {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.className = "kw-chip";
      btn.textContent = kw;
      btn.onclick = () => {
        if (busy) return;
        executeKeywordSearch(kw);
      };
      chipsContainer.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  if ($("kw-all")) $("kw-all").onclick = scanAllKeywords;
  $("kw-go").onclick = () => executeKeywordSearch();
  $("kw-input").onkeydown = (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      executeKeywordSearch();
    }
  };

  setOpen(false);
})();
</file>

<file path="blinkit-deals.js">
/**
 * Blinkit Deal Hunter & Scout Suite v3.5
 * Paste into the DevTools console on https://blinkit.com (delivery location already set)
 * or run via the 1-click mobile/desktop bookmarklet.
 *
 * - Server-side discount_desc sorting with 59% early-exit cutoff for lightning-fast crawls.
 * - 1-Click Popular Keyword chips (15 essential categories) for instant deal scouting.
 * - ⚡ Scan All Deals: Mega Scout strictly fetching Page 1 of 36 essential categories.
 * - In-memory session caching (searchCache & catDealsCache) for instant reloads.
 * - Responsive 5-column desktop and 3-column mobile grid with clickable product cards.
 * - Results tab opens strictly AFTER products are fetched, deduplicated, and sorted.
 * - Graceful cancellation: displays partial deals collected if stopped mid-scan.
 */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const ROOT_ID = "bk-deal-hunter";
  const existing = document.getElementById(ROOT_ID);
  if (existing) {
    const root = existing.shadowRoot && existing.shadowRoot.getElementById("root");
    if (root) {
      const wasOpen = root.classList.contains("open");
      root.classList.toggle("open", !wasOpen);
      if (!wasOpen) {
        const kw = existing.shadowRoot.getElementById("kw-input");
        if (kw) kw.focus();
      }
      return;
    }
    existing.remove();
  }
  ["blinkit-sort-tester-container", "dh-overlay"].forEach((id) => document.getElementById(id)?.remove());

  // ---------- Context (100% Dynamic Location from Blinkit) ----------
  const cookie = (n) => {
    const m = document.cookie.match(new RegExp("(?:^|; )" + n + "=([^;]*)"));
    if (!m) return "";
    try { return decodeURIComponent(m[1]); } catch { return m[1]; }
  };

  const getDynamicContext = () => {
    const pre = (window.grofers && window.grofers.PRELOADED_STATE && window.grofers.PRELOADED_STATE.data) || {};
    const loc = pre.location || {};
    const preCoords = loc.coords || {};

    let storageCoords = {}, storageLocality = "";
    try {
      for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
        const k = localStorage.key(i);
        if (k && /location|address|coords|user_loc/i.test(k)) {
          try {
            const val = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k));
            if (val && typeof val === "object") {
              if (val.lat && val.lon) storageCoords = val;
              else if (val.coords && val.coords.lat) storageCoords = val.coords;
              const candLoc = val.display_address || val.name || val.locality || val.cityName || val.area;
              if (candLoc && typeof candLoc === "string" && !/^\d+$/.test(candLoc.trim())) {
                storageLocality = candLoc.trim();
              }
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    const lat = preCoords.lat || cookie("gr_1_lat") || storageCoords.lat || "";
    const lon = preCoords.lon || cookie("gr_1_lon") || storageCoords.lon || "";

    // City ID numbers (like '3' for Bangalore) must be rejected
    const isValidLocality = (str) => {
      if (!str || typeof str !== "string") return false;
      const s = str.trim();
      return s.length >= 2 && !/^\d+$/.test(s);
    };

    const candidates = [
      loc.display_address,
      loc.name,
      loc.locality_name,
      loc.area_name,
      loc.cityName,
      loc.city_name,
      loc.locality,
      cookie("gr_1_display_address"),
      cookie("gr_1_locality_name"),
      cookie("gr_1_city_name"),
      storageLocality,
    ];

    let locality = "";
    for (const cand of candidates) {
      if (isValidLocality(cand)) {
        locality = cand.trim();
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!locality) {
      try {
        const domEl = document.querySelector('header [class*="location"], [class*="LocationBar"], [class*="location-box"]');
        if (domEl && isValidLocality(domEl.textContent)) {
          locality = domEl.textContent.trim().split("\n")[0].slice(0, 30);
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    const chainId = String(pre.chainId || cookie("gr_1_chain_id") || "").trim();

    return {
      lat: String(lat || ""),
      lon: String(lon || ""),
      locality: locality || (lat && lon ? (chainId ? "Store " + chainId : "Selected Location") : "Location not set"),
      chainId: chainId,
      detected: !!(lat && lon),
    };
  };

  let CTX = getDynamicContext();

  const TAXONOMY = [
  {

  // ---------- Helpers ----------
  const LIMIT = 15, MAX_PAGES = 200; // safety ceiling
  const MIN_DISCOUNT_CUTOFF = 59; // Stop fetching next pages once discount drops below 59%
  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const tx = (v) => (v && typeof v === "object" ? v.text || "" : v == null ? "" : String(v));
  const toNum = (s) => { const n = parseFloat(String(s).replace(/[^0-9.]/g, "")); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0; };
  const round2 = (n) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
  const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
  const cap = (s) => String(s || "").split(" ").map((w) => (w ? w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase() : "")).join(" ");

  // Session caches to prevent duplicate calls
  const searchCache = new Map();
  const catDealsCache = new Map();

  // ---------- Parsing ----------
  function toItem(d) {
    const ci = (d.atc_action && d.atc_action.add_to_cart && d.atc_action.add_to_cart.cart_item) || null;
    const name = tx(d.name) || (ci && (ci.display_name || ci.product_name)) || "";
    const price = toNum(tx(d.normal_price)) || Number(ci && ci.price) || 0;
    let mrp = toNum(tx(d.mrp)) || Number(ci && ci.mrp) || 0;
    if (!name || !price) return null;
    if (!mrp || mrp < price) mrp = price;

    const ratingNum = parseFloat(d.rating && d.rating.value);
    let badge = "";
    if (Array.isArray(d.product_badges) && d.product_badges.length) badge = tx(d.product_badges[0]);
    else if (d.product_badge_type) badge = String(d.product_badge_type);
    const img = (d.image && (d.image.url || d.image)) || (ci && ci.image_url) || "";
    const cat = tx(d.category_name) || tx(d.category) || tx(d.l1_category) || tx(d.sub_category) || (ci && (tx(ci.category_name) || tx(ci.l1_category) || tx(ci.category))) || "";

    return {
      productId: String(d.product_id != null ? d.product_id : (ci && ci.product_id) || ""),
      name,
      category: cat,
      categories: cat ? [cat] : [],
      brand: tx(d.brand_name) || d.brand || (ci && ci.brand) || "",
      variant: tx(d.variant) || (ci && ci.unit) || "",
      mrp,
      price,
      discountPct: round2(((mrp - price) / mrp) * 100),
      savings: round2(mrp - price),
      soldOut: d.is_sold_out === true || (ci && ci.inventory === 0) || d.inventory === 0,
      rating: Number.isFinite(ratingNum) ? ratingNum : null,
      ratingCount: d.rating && d.rating.count != null ? tx(d.rating.count) : "",
      badge,
      image: typeof img === "string" && img.startsWith("https://") ? img : "",
    };
  }

  // Walks the response structure safely
  function parseItems(json) {
    const out = [];
    (function walk(node, depth) {
      if (!node || typeof node !== "object" || depth > 14) return;
      if (Array.isArray(node)) { node.forEach((n) => walk(n, depth + 1)); return; }
      const d = node.data;
      if (d && typeof d === "object" && !Array.isArray(d)) {
        const item = toItem(d);
        if (item) { out.push(item); return; }
      }
      for (const k in node) walk(node[k], depth + 1);
    })(json && json.response ? json.response : json, 0);
    return out;
  }

  // ---------- Category Listing API ----------
  async function listingPage(o, offset, pageIdx, sortKey = "discount_desc") {
    const body = {
      offset: String(offset),
      limit: String(LIMIT),
      collection_filters: "[]",
      collection_group_id: String(o.group),
      collection_properties: JSON.stringify([{ id: 4179, name: "NEXT_PRODUCT_RECOMMENDATION", value: "true" }]),
      collection_uuid: o.cat,
      exclude_combos: "false",
      last_snippet_type: "product_card_snippet_type_2",
      last_widget_type: "product_container",
      oos_visibility: "true",
      page_index: String(pageIdx),
      products: "[]",
      total_entities_processed: String(offset),
      total_pagination_items: String(LIMIT * MAX_PAGES),
      applied_filters: null,
      sort: sortKey,
    };
    const url = `https://blinkit.com/v1/layout/listing_widgets?collection_uuid=${encodeURIComponent(o.cat)}&collection_group_id=${encodeURIComponent(o.group)}&sort=${encodeURIComponent(sortKey)}`;
    const r = await fetch(url, {
      method: "POST",
      signal: o.signal,
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", app_client: "consumer_web", lat: CTX.lat, lon: CTX.lon },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
    return r.json();
  }

  function shouldStopAtCutoff(pageItems) {
    if (!pageItems || pageItems.length < LIMIT) return true;
    if (pageItems.every((it) => it.soldOut)) return true;
    const lastRow = pageItems.slice(-3);
    const hasAboveCutoff = lastRow.some((it) => Math.round(it.discountPct) >= MIN_DISCOUNT_CUTOFF);
    return !hasAboveCutoff;
  }

  // ---------- Category Crawler ----------
  async function crawl(o, onProgress) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const items = [];
    let pageIdx = 0, offset = 0, failedPages = 0, complete = false;

    while (pageIdx < MAX_PAGES) {
      if (o.signal && o.signal.aborted) {
        if (items.length > 0) {
          return { items, complete: false, partial: failedPages > 0, cancelled: true, pagesScanned: pageIdx };
        }
        throw new DOMException("Aborted", "AbortError");
      }
      let resJson;
      try {
        resJson = await listingPage(o, offset, pageIdx, "discount_desc");
      } catch (err) {
        if (err.name === "AbortError" || (o.signal && o.signal.aborted)) {
          if (items.length > 0) {
            return { items, complete: false, partial: failedPages > 0, cancelled: true, pagesScanned: pageIdx };
          }
          throw err;
        }
        failedPages++;
        break;
      }

      const pageItems = parseItems(resJson);
      let newCount = 0;
      for (const it of pageItems) {
        const key = it.productId || (it.name + "|" + it.variant);
        if (!seen.has(key)) {
          seen.add(key);
          items.push(it);
          newCount++;
        }
      }

      pageIdx++;
      offset += LIMIT;
      onProgress(items.length, pageIdx);

      if (newCount === 0 || shouldStopAtCutoff(pageItems)) {
        complete = true;
        break;
      }
      await sleep(150);
      if (o.signal && o.signal.aborted) {
        if (items.length > 0) {
          return { items, complete: false, partial: failedPages > 0, cancelled: true, pagesScanned: pageIdx };
        }
        throw new DOMException("Aborted", "AbortError");
      }
    }

    return { items, complete: complete || pageIdx >= MAX_PAGES, partial: failedPages > 0, cancelled: false, pagesScanned: pageIdx };
  }

  // ---------- Keyword Search Crawler ----------
  async function crawlSearch(keyword, onProgress, signal) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const items = [];
    let pageIdx = 0, complete = false, partial = false;
    const MAX_SEARCH_PAGES = 35; // safety cap

    while (!complete && pageIdx < MAX_SEARCH_PAGES) {
      if (signal && signal.aborted) {
        if (items.length > 0) {
          return { items, complete: false, partial, cancelled: true, pagesScanned: pageIdx };
        }
        throw new DOMException("Aborted", "AbortError");
      }

      const searchUrl = `https://blinkit.com/v1/layout/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(keyword)}&search_type=type_to_search&page_index=${pageIdx}&offset=${pageIdx * 15}&limit=15&oos_visibility=true&sort=discount_desc`;

      let json = null;
      try {
        const res = await fetch(searchUrl, {
          method: "POST",
          signal,
          headers: {
            "content-type": "application/json",
            accept: "*/*",
            app_client: "consumer_web",
            lat: CTX.lat,
            lon: CTX.lon,
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            query: keyword,
            q: keyword,
            search_query: keyword,
            page_index: pageIdx,
            offset: pageIdx * 15,
            limit: 15,
            oos_visibility: "true",
            sort: "discount_desc",
          }),
        });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);
        json = await res.json();
      } catch (err) {
        if (err.name === "AbortError" || (signal && signal.aborted)) {
          if (items.length > 0) {
            return { items, complete: false, partial, cancelled: true, pagesScanned: pageIdx };
          }
          throw err;
        }
        partial = true;
        break;
      }

      const list = parseItems(json);
      const beforeCount = items.length;

      if (list && list.length > 0) {
        list.forEach((it) => {
          const key = it.productId || (it.name + "|" + it.variant);
          if (!seen.has(key)) {
            seen.add(key);
            items.push(it);
          }
        });
      }

      if (!list || list.length === 0 || items.length === beforeCount || shouldStopAtCutoff(list)) {
        complete = true;
      }

      pageIdx++;
      onProgress(items.length, pageIdx);

      if (!complete && pageIdx < MAX_SEARCH_PAGES) {
        await sleep(500); // 500ms courtesy pause between page calls
        if (signal && signal.aborted) {
          if (items.length > 0) {
            return { items, complete: false, partial, cancelled: true, pagesScanned: pageIdx };
          }
          throw new DOMException("Aborted", "AbortError");
        }
      }
    }

    return { items, complete, partial, cancelled: false, pagesScanned: pageIdx };
  }

  // ---------- 50 Top Categories Keywords for Mega Deals Scout ----------
  const ALL_KEYWORDS = [
    "atta", "rice", "dal", "ghee", "sweets", "chocolate", "cake", "snacks",

  async function fetchKeywordPage0(keyword, signal) {
    const cacheKey = keyword.toLowerCase();
    if (searchCache.has(cacheKey)) {
      return searchCache.get(cacheKey).items;
    }
    const searchUrl = `https://blinkit.com/v1/layout/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(keyword)}&search_type=type_to_search&page_index=0&offset=0&limit=15&oos_visibility=true&sort=discount_desc`;
    const res = await fetch(searchUrl, {
      method: "POST",
      signal,
      headers: {
        "content-type": "application/json",
        accept: "*/*",
        app_client: "consumer_web",
        lat: CTX.lat,
        lon: CTX.lon,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        query: keyword,
        q: keyword,
        search_query: keyword,
        page_index: 0,
        offset: 0,
        limit: 15,
        oos_visibility: "true",
        sort: "discount_desc",
      }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);
    const json = await res.json();
    return parseItems(json);
  }

  function pageMain() {
    const D = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("data").textContent);
    const h = (tag, a, ...kids) => {
      const e = document.createElement(tag);
      for (const k in a || {}) {
        if (k === "class") e.className = a[k];
        else if (k === "text") e.textContent = a[k];
        else if (k.slice(0, 2) === "on") e.addEventListener(k.slice(2), a[k]);
        else e.setAttribute(k, a[k]);
      }
      kids.flat().forEach((c) => c != null && e.append(c.nodeType ? c : document.createTextNode(c)));
      return e;
    };
    const inr = (n) => "\u20B9" + n.toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
    // Default view: GRID
    const st = { q: "", cat: "", minDisc: 0, inStock: false, key: "discountPct", dir: -1, view: "grid" };
    const SORTS = [
      ["discountPct:-1", "Highest discount"], ["savings:-1", "Biggest savings"], ["price:1", "Price, low to high"],
      ["price:-1", "Price, high to low"], ["rating:-1", "Top rated"], ["name:1", "Name, A to Z"],
    ];

    // Extract categories
    const catCounts = new Map();
    D.items.forEach((it) => {
      const cats = (it.categories && it.categories.length) ? it.categories : (it.category ? [it.category] : []);
      cats.forEach((c) => {
        catCounts.set(c, (catCounts.get(c) || 0) + 1);
      });
    });
    const uniqueCats = Array.from(catCounts.keys()).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    let catSel = null;
    if (uniqueCats.length > 1) {
      catSel = h("select", {
        class: "sel sel-cat",
        "aria-label": "Filter by Category",
        onchange: () => {
          st.cat = catSel.value;
          render();
        }
      },
        h("option", { value: "", text: "All Categories (" + D.items.length + ")" }),
        uniqueCats.map((c) => h("option", { value: c, text: c + " (" + catCounts.get(c) + ")" }))
      );
    }

    function visible() {
      const q = st.q.trim().toLowerCase();
      const list = D.items.filter((it) => {
        const matchesQ = !q || (it.name + " " + it.brand + " " + it.variant + " " + (it.category || "")).toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesDisc = it.discountPct >= st.minDisc;
        const matchesStock = !st.inStock || !it.soldOut;
        const matchesCat = !st.cat || it.category === st.cat || (it.categories && it.categories.includes(st.cat));
        return matchesQ && matchesDisc && matchesStock && matchesCat;
      });
      list.sort((a, b) => {
        let av = a[st.key], bv = b[st.key];
        if (av == null || bv == null) return av == null ? (bv == null ? 0 : 1) : -1;
        const c = typeof av === "string" ? av.localeCompare(bv) * st.dir : (av - bv) * st.dir;
        return c || b.discountPct - a.discountPct || b.savings - a.savings || a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
      });
      return list;
    }

    const getProductUrl = (it) => {
      if (!it) return "https://blinkit.com";
      const slug = (it.name || "item").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "") || "item";
      return it.productId ? "https://blinkit.com/prn/" + slug + "/prid/" + it.productId : "https://blinkit.com/s/?q=" + encodeURIComponent(it.name);
    };

    const off = (it) => it.discountPct > 0
      ? h("span", { class: "off " + (it.discountPct >= 40 ? "hi" : it.discountPct >= 25 ? "mid" : "lo") },
          h("span", { class: "pct", text: Math.round(it.discountPct) + "%" }),
          h("span", { class: "lbl", text: "Off" }))
      : h("span", { class: "off lo", text: "\u2013" });
    const pic = (it) => it.image ? h("img", { src: it.image, alt: "", loading: "lazy", referrerpolicy: "no-referrer" }) : h("div", { class: "ph" });

    const COLS = [
      ["name", "Product", 1, "col-prod"],
      ["mrp", "MRP", 1, "col-mrp hide-s"],
      ["price", "Price", 1, "col-price"],
      ["discountPct", "Off", -1, "col-off"],
      ["savings", "Save", -1, "col-save hide-s"],
      ["rating", "Rating", -1, "col-rating hide-s"]
    ];

    function listView(rows) {
      const head = h("tr", {}, COLS.map(([key, label, dir, cls]) => {
        const th = h("th", { class: cls },
          h("button", { text: label + (st.key === key ? (st.dir < 0 ? " \u2193" : " \u2191") : ""), onclick: () => {
            if (st.key === key) st.dir *= -1; else { st.key = key; st.dir = dir; }
            render();
          } }));
        if (st.key === key) th.setAttribute("aria-sort", st.dir < 0 ? "descending" : "ascending");
        return th;
      }));
      const body = rows.map((it) => h("tr", { class: it.soldOut ? "oos" : "" },
        h("td", { class: "col-prod" }, h("a", { class: "prod", href: getProductUrl(it), target: "_blank", rel: "noopener noreferrer" },
          pic(it),
          h("div", { class: "pinfo" },
            h("div", { class: "pn", text: it.name }),
            h("div", { class: "ps" },
              h("span", { text: it.variant }),
              h("span", { text: it.brand }),
              it.category ? h("span", { class: "tag", text: it.category }) : null,
              it.soldOut ? h("span", { class: "tag", text: "Sold out" }) : null)))),
        h("td", { class: "col-mrp hide-s" }, it.discountPct > 0 ? h("span", { class: "mrp", text: inr(it.mrp) }) : ""),
        h("td", { class: "col-price price", text: inr(it.price) }),
        h("td", { class: "col-off" }, off(it)),
        h("td", { class: "col-save hide-s", text: it.savings > 0 ? inr(it.savings) : "\u2013" }),
        h("td", { class: "col-rating hide-s", text: it.rating ? "\u2605 " + it.rating + (it.ratingCount ? " (" + it.ratingCount + ")" : "") : "\u2013" })));
      return h("table", {}, h("thead", {}, head), h("tbody", {}, body));
    }

    function gridView(rows) {
      return h("div", { class: "grid" }, rows.map((it) => h("a", { class: "card" + (it.soldOut ? " oos" : ""), href: getProductUrl(it), target: "_blank", rel: "noopener noreferrer" },
        h("div", { class: "thumb" }, pic(it), it.discountPct > 0 ? off(it) : null),
        h("div", { class: "cname", text: it.name }),
        h("div", { class: "cmeta", text: (it.soldOut ? "Sold out" : it.variant) + (it.category ? " \u00B7 " + it.category : "") }),
        h("div", { class: "cprice" }, h("b", { text: inr(it.price) }), it.discountPct > 0 ? h("s", { text: inr(it.mrp) }) : null))));
    }

    function exportCsv() {
      const q = (v) => {
        let s = String(v == null ? "" : v);
        if (/^[=+\-@]/.test(s)) s = "'" + s;
        return /[",\n]/.test(s) ? '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : s;
      };
      const lines = [["Name", "Category", "Brand", "Variant", "MRP", "Price", "Discount %", "Savings", "In stock", "Rating"]]
        .concat(visible().map((i) => [i.name, i.category || "", i.brand, i.variant, i.mrp, i.price, i.discountPct, i.savings, i.soldOut ? "no" : "yes", i.rating]))
        .map((r) => r.map(q).join(","));
      const a = h("a", { href: URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([lines.join("\n")], { type: "text/csv" })), download: "blinkit-deals.csv" });
      document.body.append(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    }

    // Header summary
    const maxOff = D.items.reduce((m, i) => Math.max(m, i.discountPct), 0);
    const inStockN = D.items.filter((i) => !i.soldOut).length;
    const notes = [];
    if (D.partial) notes.push("Some pages failed to load, so this list may be incomplete.");
    if (D.cancelled) notes.push("Search stopped early by user. Showing " + D.items.length + " products collected so far.");
    else if (!D.complete) notes.push("Stopped at the safety limit of " + D.items.length + " products, so the rest of this subcategory isn't included.");

    const count = h("div", { class: "count" });
    const content = h("div", {});
    const mkChip = (label, on) => { const b = h("button", { class: "chip", "aria-pressed": "false", text: label, onclick: () => { on(); render(); } }); return b; };
    const c25 = mkChip("25%+", () => { st.minDisc = st.minDisc === 25 ? 0 : 25; });
    const c40 = mkChip("40%+", () => { st.minDisc = st.minDisc === 40 ? 0 : 40; });
    const c60 = mkChip("60%+", () => { st.minDisc = st.minDisc === 60 ? 0 : 60; });
    const cStock = mkChip("In stock", () => { st.inStock = !st.inStock; });
    const sel = h("select", { class: "sel", "aria-label": "Sort", onchange: () => { const [k, d] = sel.value.split(":"); st.key = k; st.dir = +d; render(); } },
      h("option", { value: "", hidden: "", text: "Column sort" }), SORTS.map(([v, t]) => h("option", { value: v, text: t })));
    const vGrid = h("button", { text: "Grid", onclick: () => { st.view = "grid"; render(); } });
    const vList = h("button", { text: "List", onclick: () => { st.view = "list"; render(); } });
    const search = h("input", { class: "search", type: "search", placeholder: "Search products or brands", "aria-label": "Search products", oninput: () => { st.q = search.value; render(); } });

    document.getElementById("app").append(h("div", { class: "wrap" },
      h("h1", { text: D.meta.category + " \u203A " + D.meta.subcategory }),
      h("div", { class: "meta" },
        h("span", { text: D.items.length + " products" }),
        h("span", { text: "up to " + Math.round(maxOff) + "% off" }),
        h("span", { text: inStockN + " in stock" })),
      notes.map((n) => h("div", { class: "note", text: n })),
      h("div", { class: "bar" },
        h("div", { class: "bar-row r1" }, search, c25, c40, c60),
        h("div", { class: "bar-row r2" }, cStock, catSel, sel, h("div", { class: "seg" }, vGrid, vList), h("button", { class: "chip btn-csv", text: "Export CSV", onclick: exportCsv }))),
      count, content));

    function render() {
      const rows = visible();
      c25.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.minDisc === 25); c40.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.minDisc === 40); c60.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.minDisc === 60);
      cStock.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.inStock);
      vGrid.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.view === "grid"); vList.setAttribute("aria-pressed", st.view === "list");
      sel.value = SORTS.some(([v]) => v === st.key + ":" + st.dir) ? st.key + ":" + st.dir : "";
      if (catSel) catSel.value = st.cat || "";
      count.textContent = "Showing " + rows.length + " of " + D.items.length;
      content.replaceChildren(rows.length ? (st.view === "grid" ? gridView(rows) : listView(rows)) : h("div", { class: "empty", text: "No products match these filters." }));
    }
    render();
  }

  function buildResultsHtml(data) {
    const json = JSON.stringify(data).replace(/</g, "\\u003c").replace(/\u2028/g, "\\u2028").replace(/\u2029/g, "\\u2029");
    const title = data.meta.subcategory + " deals";
    return '<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>' +
      esc(title) + '</title><style>' + RESULTS_CSS + '</style></head><body><div id="app"></div><script id="data" type="application/json">' +
      json + '</script><script>(' + pageMain.toString() + ')()</script></body></html>';
  }

  // Opens results only AFTER fetching is done
  let lastResultsHtml = null;

  function showOverlay(html) {
    let frame = document.getElementById("dh-overlay");
    if (frame) frame.remove();
    frame = document.createElement("div");
    frame.id = "dh-overlay";
    frame.style.cssText = "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483647;background:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column";

    const topBar = document.createElement("div");
    topBar.style.cssText = "display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 16px;background:#f8f9fa;border-bottom:1px solid #e4e7e1";

    const title = document.createElement("span");
    title.style.cssText = "font:600 13px system-ui;color:#171a17";
    title.textContent = "Deal Hunter Results";

    const right = document.createElement("div");
    right.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center";

    const note = document.createElement("span");
    note.style.cssText = "font:12px system-ui;color:#667064";
    note.textContent = "Pop-up blocked by browser:";

    const openTabBtn = document.createElement("button");
    openTabBtn.textContent = "Open in New Tab \u2197";
    openTabBtn.style.cssText = "padding:5px 12px;background:#0c831f;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:6px;font:600 12px system-ui;cursor:pointer";
    openTabBtn.onclick = () => {
      const w = window.open("", "_blank");
      if (w) { w.document.open(); w.document.write(html); w.document.close(); }
    };

    const closeBtn = document.createElement("button");
    closeBtn.textContent = "Close \u2715";
    closeBtn.style.cssText = "padding:5px 12px;background:#fff;color:#667064;border:1px solid #e4e7e1;border-radius:6px;font:500 12px system-ui;cursor:pointer";
    closeBtn.onclick = () => frame.remove();

    right.append(note, openTabBtn, closeBtn);
    topBar.append(title, right);

    const f = document.createElement("iframe");
    f.setAttribute("sandbox", "allow-scripts allow-downloads");
    f.style.cssText = "flex:1;border:0;width:100%";
    f.srcdoc = html;

    frame.append(topBar, f);
    document.body.append(frame);
  }

  function displayResults(html) {
    lastResultsHtml = html;
    $("view-last").hidden = false;
    let opened = false;
    try {
      const w = window.open("", "_blank");
      if (w) {
        w.document.open();
        w.document.write(html);
        w.document.close();
        opened = true;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      opened = false;
    }
    if (!opened) {
      showOverlay(html);
      return "overlay";
    }
    return "tab";
  }
